articles.title: How Have Computer Applications Changed the Way We Make Dance?
articles.description: I was one of the pioneers of what I call “computational choreography”—dance made with the assistance of computers. In 2007, I created and performed my work Choreobot with VICKi (Virtual Interactive Choreographic/Kinetic instructor), software that I coded to generate choreography, live. My experiences in this constantly evolving field give me a unique perspective on both its history and the questions AI now presses on dance.
